We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the described case. Facts: a public official (尹某) in land resources bureau, used position to accept bribes (cash and shopping cards) from a company representative (王某某) in exchange for favorable treatment in land project bidding and contracting. Total amount 139,000 yuan (13.9万元). He also gave false invoice to get 8万元? Actually he gave invoice to Wang for 8万元, but he received 80,000 cash. So it's bribery (受贿) and possibly unit bribery (单位受贿) but the list includes both "受贿" and "单位受贿". The case is about a public official receiving bribes for personal benefit. The label "受贿" is appropriate. Also "滥用职权" maybe? He used his position to benefit others, but the main crime is bribery. The list includes "受贿" and "单位受贿". Since the defendant is an individual public official, "受贿" is correct. Also "滥用职权" is a separate crime for abusing authority, but the facts focus on receiving bribes. So answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>.

Check if any other charge like "贪污" (misappropriation of public funds) not present. He didn't embezzle public funds, just accepted bribes. So single charge.
